title: RAIC Overlay Plugin Manifest v1
description: Authoritative schema for the raic-plugin.json file shipped with every plugin release.

$schema.description: Pointer to this JSON Schema for editor autocomplete. Not used by the host.

manifest_version.description: Schema version of this manifest file.

id.description: Globally unique reverse-DNS-style plugin id, e.g. com.alice.build-order-tracker.

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version, matching the GitHub release tag (with or without leading 'v').

description.description: Short description shown in the install consent screen and Settings list.

source_repo_url.description: GitHub repository URL. Only github.com is allowed in v1.

min_host_version.description: Minimum RAIC Overlay version required. Install is rejected if the running host is older.

protocol_version.description: JSON-RPC protocol version this plugin targets.

ui.description: Relative path within the bundle to the primary window's HTML file, e.g. ui/index.html. Must not start with / or \ and must not contain backslashes.

permissions.description: Capability groups the plugin needs. Known values in v1: 'notifications', 'hotkeys', 'sidecar'. Unknown values are surfaced in the consent screen as 'unrecognized permission' but do not block install.

bin.description: Relative path to the executable within the bundle.

platforms.description: Map of platform id (e.g. 'windows-x86_64') to its binary location.

icon.description: Relative path to a PNG or SVG icon shown in the Plugins dropdown.

homepage.description: Optional project homepage shown in Settings.
